patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic multi-start simulated-annealing search specialized for the 11-point Heilbronn problem. The three vertices are retained as useful extremal points, while the remaining eight points are repeatedly perturbed and projected back into the equilateral triangle. Each candidate is evaluated over all 165 triples using vectorized NumPy area computation.

The search uses a smoothed objective based on the smallest several triangle areas, rather than only the current minimum. This gives the local search useful gradient-like information when several nearly active constraints compete. The best configuration is still selected strictly by its true minimum triangle area. Fixed RNG seeds make the returned arrangement reproducible, and all proposals are explicitly projected into the feasible triangular domain.
